anonymity.caption: Hidden from everyone except people you like. Likes may slow down.

aiStarters.title: AI starters

weMet.title: Use my We Met feedback
weMet.caption: Your post-date check-ins teach the matching loop what works for you.

resetMatching.title: Reset matching history
resetMatching.caption: Clears learned preferences. Your profile stays.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.caption: Date-Coin balance, keys and ecosystem switch.

safetyResources.title: Safety resources
safetyResources.caption: Hotlines and expert help, whenever you need them.

queueDrop.title: Queue drop
queueDrop.caption: Daily at noon, when your new queue lands.

events.title: Events
events.caption: RSVP updates and new events near you.

hiddenWords.title: Hidden words
hiddenWords.intro: Messages containing these are filtered to a hidden folder you can review.
hiddenWords.inputAria: Add a hidden word or phrase
hiddenWords.hint: Tap the × on a chip to remove it. Filtering is silent — senders aren’t told.

blocked.title: Blocked accounts
blocked.intro: Blocked people can’t see you, like you, or message you.
blocked.emptyBody: If you block someone, they’ll show up here.
blocked.sheetBody: They’ll be able to see your profile and message you again. You can re-block any time.

anonymity.title: Turn on anonymity mode?
anonymity.p1: You’ll be hidden from everyone except people you like.
anonymity.p2: The honest tradeoff: fewer people see you, so likes may slow down.
anonymity.p3: You can switch back any time — nothing else changes.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.body: Only date reminders come through during quiet hours.

reset.title: Reset matching history?
reset.body: This clears what Resonance learned from your likes, passes, and We Met check-ins. Your profile, matches, and messages stay.

delete.pausedP1: You won’t appear in anyone’s queue.
delete.pausedP2: Your profile, matches, and messages are exactly where you left them.
delete.beforeP1: Deleting removes your profile, matches, messages, and Pulses. This can’t be undone.
delete.beforeP2: If you just need a break, pausing hides you without losing anything.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.deletedBody: Everything is gone. Thanks for the time you spent here — we hope you met someone worth meeting.
delete.lastStep: Last step. Press and hold below to permanently delete your account.

safety.title: Safety resources
safety.body: Free, confidential, 24/7. You don’t have to handle anything alone.
safety.crisisCaption: Text HOME to 741741 — trained counselors, any crisis
safety.emergency: In immediate danger? Call your local emergency number first.

help.title: Help center
help.body: A searchable help center is coming soon. Until then, “Download my data” and the safety tools above cover the most common requests — and safety resources are always one tap away.
help.emailCaption: support@resonanse.app — we reply within one business day

footer: RESONANCE 1.0.0 · MADE FOR MEETING IN REAL LIFE.
